summary: Iteration 213: Passkeys/WebAuthn Frontend Flow Testing - All features verified successfully. Backend APIs (GET/DELETE passkeys) working correctly. Frontend PasskeyManager component renders in ENZI Profile modal with correct data-testids. All login pages have passkey options.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend GET /api/auth/passkeys correctly returns passkeys list for authenticated user (excludes public_key for security)
Backend DELETE /api/auth/passkeys/{credential_id} correctly returns 404 for non-existent credential
Backend returns 401 for unauthenticated users on both GET/DELETE passkey endpoints
PasskeyManager component correctly imports and renders in UserProfileModal.jsx (line 272)
PasskeyManager has data-testid='add-passkey-btn' on Add Passkey button
PasskeyManager has data-testid='no-passkeys-msg' for empty state message
PasskeyManager shows info text about biometric authentication
ENZI login page (LumiLogin.jsx) has passkey flow with data-testid='lumi-passkey-btn'
MedMatch login page (LoginPage.jsx) has biometric tab with BiometricLogin component (data-testid='biometric-tab')
KARAU Meet login page (KarauMeetLogin.jsx) has Passkey button (data-testid='btn-passkey') under 'More sign-in options'
Security section in Profile modal appears between Theme and Capabilities as expected
context_for_next_testing_agent: Passkey WebAuthn flow is fully implemented. Backend endpoints for listing/deleting passkeys work correctly. PasskeyManager component renders in ENZI Profile modal. Actual passkey registration requires real browser biometric interaction and cannot be automated. All login pages (ENZI, MedMatch KARAU, KARAU Meet) have passkey/biometric options.

tested_features.feature: Backend: GET /api/auth/passkeys returns list of passkeys for authenticated user
Backend: GET /api/auth/passkeys returns 401 for unauthenticated user
Backend: DELETE /api/auth/passkeys/{credential_id} returns 404 for non-existent credential
Backend: DELETE /api/auth/passkeys/{credential_id} returns 401 for unauthenticated user
Backend: POST /api/auth/passkey/register/start returns 404 for non-existent user
Backend: POST /api/auth/passkey/register/start returns challenge for existing user
Backend: POST /api/auth/passkey/login/start returns 404 when no passkeys registered
Frontend: ENZI Profile modal shows 'Passkeys & Security' section
Frontend: PasskeyManager shows empty state ('No passkeys registered') when no passkeys exist
Frontend: PasskeyManager shows info text about biometric authentication
Frontend: data-testid='add-passkey-btn' exists on the Add Passkey button
Frontend: data-testid='no-passkeys-msg' exists for empty state
Frontend: ENZI login page has 'Sign in with Passkey' option under 'More sign-in options'
Frontend: MedMatch login page has 'biometric' tab with BiometricLogin component
Frontend: KARAU Meet login page has Passkey button under 'More sign-in options'
Frontend: Profile modal can be opened by clicking user email in sidebar
Frontend: Security section appears between Theme and Capabilities in profile modal

mocked_apis.notes: WebAuthn credential creation requires real browser biometric interaction and cannot be automated in testing. All backend API tests are against real endpoints.
